note: Heterozygous SPTAN1 mutations cause pure motor neuropathy (dHMN11), whereas epilepsy and severe neurodevelopmental delay are hallmarks of DEE5 and complex SPTAN1 encephalopathy syndromes.

evidence.text: Heterozygous nonsense mutations in SPTAN1 were identified in hereditary motor neuropathy (HMN) kindreds, contrasting with the gene's prior description in epileptic syndromes.

source.title: Hereditary motor neuropathies
source.quote: HMN phenotype of variable severity, Beijer et al. [18▪] identified heterozygous nonsense mutations in SPTAN1, a gene previously described in the context of epilepsy syndromes.

evidence.text: SPTAN1 spectrum encompasses distal hereditary motor neuronopathy as well as cohorts exhibiting developmental delay with or without seizures.
